snippet.title: Animal Game - Official Playtest Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Playtest Trailer for Animal Game, a multiplayer rogue-lite party brawler developed by 9UP Games. Players will pick a cute animal to head into battle, where evolution comes from death. Grab a weapon to take on enemies and friends alike to attain upgrades in the pursuit of victory. No one's safe in Animal Game, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a playtest available now on Steam.
